name: Hall-effect tank/switch-node current sensing with built-in overcurrent flag
function: Measures transformer (tank) current at 100 kHz with an isolated Hall sensor (1 MHz bandwidth) whose overcurrent output trips the PWM through an MCU input.

inputs.name: IN+ / IN-
inputs.range: set by sensitivity option (B1A: 25 mV/A per current datasheet)

outputs.name: FAULT
outputs.description: overcurrent flag to MCU trip input

operating_conditions: Overcurrent thresholds set by a VOC divider: 45 A primary, 70 A secondary (TIDA-010054).
interface_requirements: MCU input configured to trip PWM on FAULT (TIDA-010054 uses GPIO to trip zone).
pcb_constraints: Integrated conductor in series with the transformer path; sensor body bridges the isolation gap with the datasheet creepage (>= 8 mm).
validation_notes: Threshold divider equation is in the sensor datasheet, not the design guide; AIPE did not recompute the 45 A/70 A settings.
limitations: Working-voltage capability differs between the TI guide (1100 VDC) and the current datasheet (1343 VDC reinforced).
Orderable number in the TI BOM is not listed in the current datasheet revision.
